basic_info.description: This legendary building was once home to some of tech's most visionary minds where innovation & creativity thrived. Now, a rare opportunity awaits to own a space defined by incredible volume, 4 distinct outdoor areas, luxury kitchen & bath features, & sweeping skyline views from every angle. Guests are welcomed by a breathtaking 37+/- ft atrium crowned by an 12-ft angled skylight flooding the home with natural light & architectural drama. The remodeled kitchen boasts sleek Leicht motorized cabinetry, waterfall-edge stone island, top-tier appliances, Wolf cooktop, Miele oven, Sub-Zero fridge, dual wine fridges & its own outdoor space with BBQ gas line. At its heart, the expansive living room showcases a marble fireplace against a wall of glass, with automated shades & electric window opener for effortless light & temp control. The open layout flows to a dining area with custom cabinetry. Above, an open office loft leads to the rooftop retreat. Two primary suites offer remodeled en-suite bathrooms with Graff shower fixtures. The entertainer's rooftop features a wet bar, fire pit, outdoor heater, hot tub with city views, & south-facing vistas. Additional features: Sonos system, recessed speakers, AC, radiant heat, & 2-car parking. Luxury & design in a one-of-a-kind creative space.
